== Biography ==
Ann was born in 1779.
== Research Notes ==
The current profile records birth on 24 January 1779 at Ashover and a Manchester marriage on 30 September 1805 to [[Glasgow-3545|William Glasgow]]. These held profile fields and the FamilySearch source list have not been independently verified in this review. Their daughter is [[Glasgow-3544|Agnes Glasgow]].

=== Manchester burial and spouse comparisons ===

Two Manchester burial indexes name Ann Glasgow, aged 83, at All Saints, Chorlton upon Medlock, in September 1861. The generic Date fields differ, giving 24 September and 19 September; the latter names spouse William Glasgow.<ref name="AnnManchester1861">Findmypast, ''England, Greater Manchester Burials 1570-1990'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_102734961453 R_102734961453] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_102734966682 R_102734966682], Ann Glasgow, female, aged 83, Chorlton upon Medlock, All Saints, Manchester. Date fields are 24 September and 19 September 1861 respectively; the second names spouse William Glasgow. Saved derivative transcripts inspected 22 October 2026; original register not inspected.</ref> Ann Denham is a compatible married-name comparison, not an established identification. No death or burial date is assigned to her. The indexed birth year 1778 is age-derived, and the records do not establish a maiden surname.

An 1848 All Saints index names William Glasgow, male, aged 64, with spouse Ann Glasgow and a generic Date of 5 April. Another William index gives 8 April and the same age without a spouse.<ref name="ManchesterBurials1848">Findmypast, ''England, Greater Manchester Burials 1570-1990'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_102734966661 R_102734966661] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_102734948331 R_102734948331], William Glasgow, male, aged 64, Chorlton upon Medlock, All Saints, Manchester, 1848. The generic Date fields are 5 April and 8 April respectively; only the first names spouse Ann Glasgow. Derivative transcripts inspected 4 November 2026; original register not inspected.</ref> The spouse Ann may be this woman, but the original register has not been inspected. The entry does not establish Ann as the deceased person or give a date for her death.

The original newspaper notice for William Glasgow, an ironfounder and engineer of Great Bridgewater-street, Manchester, reports his death on 5 April 1848, aged 66; it was published on 12 April.<ref name="Manchester1848">''Manchester Courier and Lancashire General Advertiser'', 12 April 1848, Deaths, column 1, printed page 240 (viewer page 6), [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/image-viewer?issue=BL%2F0000206%2F18480412&page=0006&article=049&stringtohighlight=william+glasgow William Glasgow notice]. Original printed page inspected 4 November 2026. The notice reports death on 5 April, aged 66, at his residence in Great Bridgewater-street, Manchester, describing him as an ironfounder and engineer. The [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_104260820296 derivative index R_104260820296] repeats the publication date as death date; the original gives the fifth.</ref> It names no spouse or parents. Neither William's identity as [[Glasgow-3545|her husband]] nor Ann's identity as the index spouse is proved by that notice. A possible death-date versus burial-date distinction between the 5 and 8 April index fields remains untested, and the ages 64 and 66 differ. No occupation or residence is assigned to her husband from these comparisons.

The existing family attachments, birth fields and relationship grades remain unchanged. The original All Saints register and independent household, address or occupation evidence are needed to connect these records. Glasgow is her recorded married surname in this comparison; her current birth surname remains Denham.
